title: Bade badon se bada hai
body:
Bade badon se bada hai
Husain ka asghar
<<MINI>>
bade bado se bada hai husain ka asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
husainiyat ki baqa hai husain ka asghar
<<MINI>>
bade bado se bada hai husain ka asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ghuroor karti thi jis hurmala pe fauj e yazeed..(2)
usi pe rann me hasa hai husain ka asghar
2. Jo maangna hai to jhule ki simt aa jao..(2)
ameer e karbobala hai husain ka asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Kabhi shaoor ki ankho se padh kitaab e atash..(2)
waraq waraq pe likha hai husain ka asghar
4. Qadam utha nahi paya magar yazeed tere..(2)
qadam ukhaad gaya hai husain ka asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Bilaal ab meri qaamat ko kaun naapega..(2)
meri jabee pe likha hai husain ka asghar
<<MINI>>
bade bado se bada hai husain ka asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
author: Mir Hassan Mir
